description: This PHP source file contains functions related to displaying and managing case updates within the SuiteCRM system, including rendering updates, handling AJAX calls for updating case notes, and generating attachment links.

classes.name: AOP_Case_Updates
classes.description: Represents a case update entity, used to fetch linked notes, contacts, and users related to a specific update.

methods.name: display_updates
methods.description: Renders the HTML to display the list of case updates along with toggle and expand/collapse controls, incorporating JavaScript for AJAX update handling.

methods.name: display_update_form
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the quick create/edit form for case updates, utilizing Smarty templates.

methods.name: getUpdateDisplayHead
methods.description: Generates the header HTML for a single update, including contact or user details and attached notes.

methods.name: display_single_update
methods.description: Creates the HTML block for a single case update, formatted based on whether it's an internal, contact, or assigned user update.

methods.name: display_case_attachments
methods.description: Provides HTML links to attached notes of a case.

methods.name: quick_edit_case_updates
methods.description: Generates the inline form and JavaScript necessary for quick editing of case updates on the detail view.
